title: Firefox Smart Window adds AI web search, automatic tab groups, and more - 9to5Mac
summary: Mozilla today announced new features to Firefox’s AI-powered Smart Window, which remains in beta. Smart Window now benefits from a new partnership between Mozilla and Exa , which was also announced today.
